sources.title: Rome2Rio: KL to Malacca
sources.claim: KL to Malacca is a ~2h express bus from TBS to Melaka Sentral, running very frequently.

sources.title: CheckMyBus: KL to Tanah Rata
sources.claim: KL to Cameron Highlands (Tanah Rata) is a ~3.5-4h mountain bus from TBS.

sources.title: GeckoRoutes: Cameron Highlands to Penang
sources.claim: Cameron Highlands to Penang is a direct bus of about 4.5 hours.

sources.title: Penang-Langkawi ferry status
sources.claim: The direct Penang-Langkawi passenger ferry has been suspended for 2026.

sources.title: Trip.com: Penang to Langkawi flight
sources.claim: Penang to Langkawi is a ~40-minute direct flight.

sources.title: Malaysia Traveller: Langkawi ferries
sources.claim: With the Penang ferry down, the closest mainland ferry to Langkawi is from Kuala Perlis (~1h15).

sources.title: Rome2Rio: Langkawi to Kota Bharu
sources.claim: Langkawi to Kota Bharu has no direct flight; fly via KL (~3h+) or go overland.

sources.title: Malaysia Uncovered: Kota Bharu to Perhentian
sources.claim: From Kota Bharu, reach the Perhentians via Kuala Besut then a 30-40min ferry.

sources.title: Han Travel: Perhentian to Taman Negara transfer
sources.claim: A direct shared van links the Perhentians and Taman Negara, a cross-country day of ~8-9h.

sources.title: GeckoRoutes: Taman Negara to KL
sources.claim: Taman Negara to KL routes via Jerantut; from 13 May 2026 KL departures move to Terminal Bersepadu Gombak.

sources.title: Trip.com: KL to Kota Kinabalu flight
sources.claim: KL to Kota Kinabalu is a ~2h35 direct flight, very frequent.

sources.title: FlightsFrom: KK to Sandakan
sources.claim: Kota Kinabalu to Sandakan is a ~45-50min flight; AirAsia is the only direct operator.

sources.title: FlightRoutes: Sandakan to Kuching
sources.claim: There are no direct flights between Sandakan and Kuching; the route connects via Kota Kinabalu.

sources.title: FlightsFrom: Kuching to KL
sources.claim: Kuching to KL is a ~1h50 direct flight, ~18 flights/day.

sources.title: Malaysia Uncovered: Perhentian when to go
sources.claim: Perhentian resorts close by early November and reopen late February; ferries fully suspended Nov-Feb.

sources.title: AirTraveler: East-coast monsoon warning
sources.claim: The NE monsoon brings ~25 rain days in November to east-coast islands, closing resorts and cancelling flights.

sources.title: Backpacking Bella: Perhentian beach life
sources.claim: The Perhentians' reliable window is roughly April/May to September.

sources.title: EcotourMalaysia: best time for Kinabatangan
sources.claim: Sabah's dry season (March-October) gives the best Kinabatangan wildlife viewing; accessible year-round.

sources.title: Down Below: Kinabatangan wildlife guide 2026
sources.claim: Peak Kinabatangan wildlife activity is May-August when fruiting trees draw animals to the riverbanks.

sources.title: Bookaway: Cameron Highlands to Penang
sources.claim: Cameron Highlands to Penang is served by minivan and bus operators from ~US$12.
